items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We played Carnegie Hall in 1978, and it was a coincidence that Bebo Valdés was visiting New York when that was happening. So, he got the chance to see his son after almost 20 years without seeing him.

ctx.x: That’s when you played Carnegie Hall, right?

We played Carnegie Hall in 1978, and it was a coincidence that Bebo Valdés was visiting New York when that was happening. So, he got the chance to see his son after almost 20 years without seeing him.
